column1: So let me just finish one thing I should have said about this isomorphism theorem or the quotient group. So last time we showed that if you had a group G and you had a normal subgroup H, that there is a new group that one can construct G mod H, quotient group of cosets of H.
column2: 让我先补充一件关于这个同构定理或商群我本该说的事。上次我们证明了，如果你有一个群G，且有一个正规子群 H，那么可以构造出一个新群 G/H，即由 H 的陪集构成的商群。这个群的元素就是 H 的陪集。

column1: So the elements of this group are the cosets of H. That this comes with a natural surjective map f that takes an element in G into its H coset.
column2: 它伴随一个自然的满射 f，将 G 中的元素映为其 H陪集。

column1: That's a group homomorphism and the kernel of it is H. That's what we showed last time. So any normal subgroup gives rise to a diagram like this of groups.
column2: 那是一个群同态，且其核就是 H。这就是我们上次证明的。因此任何正规子群都会诱导出一个像这样的群图表。

column1: Now let's make a little observation which is quite useful. Namely suppose that between G and H we have another group called K.
column2: 现在我们来做个非常有用的观察：假设在 G 和 H 之间我们还有另一个群 K。

column1: So K is a subgroup of G that contains the normal subgroup H. We'll have examples of this. All right. Then the claim is first that H is normal in K.
column2: 所以 K 是包含正规子群 H 的 G 的子群。我们会有很多例子。好的，那么首先断言：H 在 K 中也是正规的。

column1: That's easy because to say H is normal in G means that for any g in G, gHg^{-1} is equal to H for all g in G.
column2: 这很容易，因为说 H 在 G 中正规，意味着对任意 g ∈ G，gHg⁻¹ 等于 H 对所有g ∈ G 都成立。

column1: Now if this is true for all g in G, it's certainly true for all g in the subgroup K, which is the statement that H is normal in K. That's easy.
column2: 既然这对 G 中的所有 g 都成立，那对子群 K 中的所有 g 自然也成立，这就是说H 在 K 中也是正规的。这很显然。

column1: So therefore we can construct the quotient group.
column2: 因此我们可以构造商群。

column1: So have group K/H which can be thought of as a subset of G/H. These are precisely the H cosets that contain elements in K.
column2: 于是有群 K/H，它可以看作 G/H 的一个子集。这些恰好是包含 K 中元素的 H 陪集。

column1: So here's the picture. If we take G and we divide it up into the distinct cosets for H, a certain number of them will form the subgroup K because K itself is a union of H cosets, and a certain number of them give you K and the rest of them give you G.
column2: 图景是这样的：如果我们把 G 划分成 H 的各个不相交陪集，其中一部分会构成子群 K，因为 K 本身就是若干 H 陪集的并集；其中一部分给出了 K，其余的则构成了 G。

column1: So you get a group which is a subset of this group.
column2: 所以你得到了一个群，它是这个群的子集。

column1: All right, first statement, it's a subgroup of G mod H because K is a subgroup of G. In other words, if I take two different cosets that lie in K, Ha and Hb, and I multiply them, that coset also lies in K.
column2: 好，第一个断言是：它是G/H 的一个子群，因为 K 是 G 的子群。换言之，如果我在 K 中取两个不同的陪集 Ha 和 Hb，并且将它们相乘，所得陪集也落在 K 中。

column1: So this subset of cosets that lie in K is closed under multiplication.
column2: 所以 K 中包含的这个陪集子集在乘法下是封闭的。

column1: Why? Because if I take two elements in K, a and b, and I multiply them, I get a new element in K.
column2: 为什么？因为如果我取 K 中的两个元素 a 和 b 并将它们相乘，得到的新元素仍属于 K。

column1: That's because K is a subgroup.
column2: 这是因为 K 是子群。

column1: The cosets contained in K are stable under multiplication as K is stable under multiplication.
column2: 包含在 K 中的陪集在乘法下保持封闭，就像 K 在乘法下封闭一样。

column1: Okay. So if I have a group containing K, H, then in the quotient group G mod H I get the subgroup K mod H.
column2: 好。因此如果我有一个包含 H 的群 K，那么在商群 G/H 中我就得到了子群 K/H。

column1: Okay. Conversely, and this is very powerful, any subgroup of G containing H corresponds to a subgroup of G mod H in this manner.
column2: 好的。反过来——这是非常强有力的性质——包含 H 的 G 的任意子群，都以这种方式对应于 G/H 的一个子群。

column1: Well, if I have a subgroup of G mod H, let's say that the subgroup consists of the cosets aH, a subset of the cosets of G mod H, and then I just take the union of all those cosets.
column2: 如果我有 G/H 的一个子群，假设该子群由陪集 aH 构成，即 G/H 中陪集的一个子集，然后我把所有这些陪集取并集。

column1: I claim that gives me a subgroup of G corresponding to the subgroup.
column2: 我断言这会给出G 的一个子群，对应于该商子群。

column1: So you have to check that that gives a subgroup of G containing H and that every subgroup of G containing H arises in that manner.
column2: 因此你需要验证这确实给出了包含 H 的 G 的子群，且包含 H 的 G 的每个子群都源于这种方式。

column1: So in other words, there's a bijection between the subgroups of G containing a normal subgroup and the subgroups of this quotient group.
column2: 换言之，包含正规子群的 G 的子群，与该商群的子群之间存在双射（一一对应）。

column1: Okay, so that's an important—so I'll give you an example of this which we'll use later on.

column1: Okay. Now suppose I asked you and let p be a prime number and consider the subgroup H which is multiples of p. So I claim, here's the claim. If we have a subgroup of Z which lies between Z and pZ as a subgroup, then either K is equal to the integers or K is equal to pZ.

column1: Maximal meaning anything larger than it is the entire group. You can't get any bigger.

column1: Okay. So that's the kind of way we're going to use this quotient theorem. We're going to use it to pick out—you get a wonderful thing from this picture.
